title: SSRF - Insufficient Protocol Validation and URL Scheme Bypass
description:
The sku_url.php endpoint relies solely on filter_var($url, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) for URL validation, which only checks if the URL is in valid format and does NOT properly validate the protocol/scheme being used. This creates multiple bypass opportunities allowing attackers to use alternative protocols beyond HTTP/HTTPS.

The vulnerable code:
```php
if (filter_var($url, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) === FALSE) {
    return 'Invalid URL';
}
$urlComponents = parse_url($url);
// No scheme validation here!
// Directly calls file_get_contents($url)
```

The vulnerability exists because:
1. filter_var() with FILTER_VALIDATE_URL only validates URL format, NOT the protocol scheme
2. No explicit whitelist of allowed protocols (http/https only)
3. PHP's file_get_contents() supports multiple protocol wrappers through stream wrapper handlers
4. Dangerous protocols like file://, gopher://, dict://, ftp://, ldap://, php:// are accepted

Attack vectors enabled by this vulnerability:
- file:// protocol - potential local file disclosure
- gopher:// protocol - access internal services via Gopher protocol
- dict:// protocol - access Redis or other services via dictionary protocol
- ftp:// protocol - access FTP servers
- ldap:// protocol - LDAP injection attacks
- php:// protocol - PHP wrapper abuse (filter, input, etc.)
impact:
HIGH - An attacker can:
1. Read local files using file:// protocol (if wrapper enabled)
2. Access FTP servers via ftp:// protocol  
3. Interact with internal services using gopher://, dict://, ldap:// protocols
4. Access Redis servers via dict:// protocol SSRF
5. Bypass intended HTTP/HTTPS restrictions using alternative protocols
6. Chain attacks with other vulnerabilities to read sensitive configuration files
7. Perform LDAP injection attacks against internal directory services
references: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type, PHP URL Wrappers documentation, OWASP SSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet, PHP filter_var() FILTER_VALIDATE_URL limitations, CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N
